question.question: Can Vagabond craft a card requiring fox and rabbit icons from one clearing, reuse the pawn for multiple craftings, and immediately use a crafted item?

expected.expected_answer: Cannot satisfy mixed suits because clearing must match every icon. Each icon exhausts hammer, pawn may activate repeatedly ignoring once/turn cap. Crafted item can immediately be taken face up, usable if otherwise eligible.

source_passages.quotation: - **Craft:** Exhaust one hammer per crafting icon; pawn acts as crafting piece matching current clearing, and may activate repeatedly despite normal once-per-turn crafting limit. Clearing must match **all icons**; cannot craft mixed fox/rabbit/mouse requirements from one clearing. When you craft an item, you may immediately take that item face up into Satchel/track and **use it for another Daylight action immediately**, if its cost and other requirements are met. Need supply item as usual.

source_passages.section: Actions — Shared movement, crafting and battle — Vagabond craft costs
source_passages.quotation: - **Vagabond cost and reuse:** The pawn **may activate repeatedly in a turn**. For each icon, **pay by exhausting one face-up, undamaged hammer: flip that hammer face down**. The pawn's **current clearing must match every icon on the card**. Reusing the pawn never waives the hammer payment per icon. One clearing cannot pay mixed fox/rabbit/mouse icons.

answer.part: Fox and rabbit icons from one clearing
answer.ruling: No. The Vagabond pawn acts as a crafting piece matching its current clearing, and that clearing must match every icon. It cannot pay mixed fox and rabbit requirements from one clearing.
The pawn may activate repeatedly and may craft despite the normal once-per-turn crafting-piece limit. It still must exhaust one hammer per icon; reuse does not waive the per-icon hammer cost.

answer.ruling: When crafting an item, the Vagabond may immediately take it face up into Satchel or its track and use it for another Daylight action immediately, if its cost and other requirements are met.
